   120→	defer l.RUnlock()

   122→	topic := string(stream.Protocol())

   167→	defer l.Unlock()
   168→
   169→	topic := string(stream.Protocol())
   170→	log := l.topicLogger(topic)
   171→
   172→	collector, err := l.retrieveCollector(topic)
   173→	if err != nil {

   182→func (l *limiter) addRawStream(stream network.Stream) {

   198→// frees all the collectors and removes them.
   199→func (l *limiter) free() {
   200→	l.Lock()
   201→	defer l.Unlock()
   202→
   203→	tempMap := map[uintptr]bool{}
   204→	for t, collector := range l.limiterMap {
   205→		// Check if collector has already been cleared off
   206→		// as all collectors are not distinct from each other.
   207→		ptr := reflect.ValueOf(collector).Pointer()
   208→		if tempMap[ptr] {
   209→			// Remove from map
   210→			delete(l.limiterMap, t)
   211→			continue
   212→		}
   213→		collector.Free()
   214→		// Remove from map
   215→		delete(l.limiterMap, t)
   216→		tempMap[ptr] = true
   217→	}
   218→}

   222→func (l *limiter) retrieveCollector(topic string) (*leakybucket.Collector, error) {
   223→	if !mutexasserts.RWMutexLocked(&l.RWMutex) && !mutexasserts.RWMutexRLocked(&l.RWMutex) {
   224→		return nil, errors.New("limiter.retrieveCollector: caller must hold read/write lock")
   225→	}
   226→	collector, ok := l.limiterMap[topic]
   227→	if !ok {
   228→		return nil, errors.Errorf("collector does not exist for topic %s", topic)
   229→	}
   230→	return collector, nil
   231→}
